description: Create, update (metrics, dates, description, hypothesis, baseline/comparison treatments, status), or delete Harness FME feature-flag experiments. Delegates metric selection to choose-metric, metric creation to create-metric, event wiring to instrument-metric, results to review-experiment-results, flag/definition prep to create-feature-flag and update-flag-targeting. Use when asked to create, modify, pause, resume, complete, or delete an experiment. Do not use for explaining results (review-experiment-results). Trigger phrases: create experiment, set up A/B test, design experiment, launch test, update experiment, pause/resume/complete experiment, delete experiment.
